question: \(f(x)=x^3-3x\). What is \(f'(2)\)?
solution:
Differentiating term by term gives \(f'(x)=3x^2-3\). Substituting \(x=2\) gives
\[
f'(2)=3\times2^2-3=3\times4-3=9.
\]
